answer: The network can pair agents at random each epoch for a small cooperative task: two strangers must co-sign a shared result, and the reward splits only when both submit honestly. Like a falcon stooping on prey, the pairing is swift and unpredictable, so no operator can place its puppets together. An honest agent plays one round cheaply, soft as velvet; a sybil farmer must make every fake hold its own in a real partnership, and two fakes together betray themselves by identical moves - a tell as clear as an opal. Each pairing burns real work per identity, so cloning multiplies effort, not reward.
